lines.text: I'm so sorry. Really, I am. I can't tell you how sorry I am. We thought...
I thought you were pirates. That's why we shot at you.
Can you please forgive me? Please?
Seems like Glyde and his bunch have heard there's a key to the Mother Lode here.
They've been attacking us for a while now.
We're all right. Our ship wasn't badly damaged either.
Don't worry about it, sir. I'll have the flutter fixed in no time at all.
Well, things are a little hectic around here right now.
What with the pirates and all.
But make yourselves at home. Feel free to visit the Digger's Guild.
